def parse_col(x: str) -> tuple[str]:
    x = x.replace("_conf_None", "")
    pairs = x.split("__")
    return (pairs[0], pairs[1][3:], pairs[2][4:], pairs[3][6:].strip("_"))

def add_ratio_lines(ax, start, stop, maximum):
    ratios = np.logspace(start, stop, 2 * (stop - start) + 1, base=2)[::-1]
    max_ratio = np.max(np.abs([start, stop]))
    for ratio in ratios:
        alpha = np.abs(np.log2(ratio)) / max_ratio
        x = np.linspace(0, maximum, 10)
        if not np.isclose(ratio, 1):
            ax.plot(x, x * ratio, ls='dotted', label=f"Ratio: {ratio:.3f}", color="red", alpha=alpha)
        else:
            ax.plot([0, maximum], [0, maximum], ls="--", color="k", label=f"Ratio: {1:.3f}", alpha=0.5)
    return ax

    ("Old", "asphalt", pd.read_excel(os.path.join(old_dir, path), sheet_name="asphalt")),

)

def plot_EAEL_by_raster(
    old_EAD_EAEL: pd.DataFrame,
    new_EAD_EAEL: pd.DataFrame,
    agg: [Callable | str],
    quantity_label: str,
    log=False
) -> None:

    hazards = old_EAD_EAEL.hazard.unique()
    RCPs = sorted(old_EAD_EAEL.rcp.unique())
    epochs = sorted(old_EAD_EAEL.epoch.unique())
    
    data = []
    for hazard in hazards:
        for RCP in RCPs:
            for epoch in epochs:
                with np.errstate(divide='ignore'):
                    with warnings.catch_warnings():
                        warnings.simplefilter(action='ignore', category=FutureWarning)
                        old_value = old_EAD_EAEL.loc[
                            (old_EAD_EAEL.hazard==hazard) &
                            (old_EAD_EAEL.rcp==RCP) &
                            (old_EAD_EAEL.epoch==epoch),
                            "EAEL_undefended_mean"
                        ].agg(agg)
                        new_value = new_EAD_EAEL.loc[
                            (new_EAD_EAEL.hazard==hazard) &
                            (new_EAD_EAEL.rcp==RCP) &
                            (new_EAD_EAEL.epoch==epoch),
                            "EAEL_undefended_mean"
                        ].agg(agg)
                try:
                    if old_value == 0 and new_value == 0:
                        continue
                    else:
                        with np.errstate(divide='ignore'):
                            if log:
                                print(f"{hazard} {RCP} {epoch} | ", end="")
                                print(f"old: {old_value:.3E}, new: {new_value:.3E} new is {(100 * new_value / old_value):.2f}% of old")
                            data.append((hazard, new_value, old_value))
                except ValueError:
                    continue
    
    df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=("peril", "new", "old"))
    f, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 4))
    for peril in df.peril.unique():
        ax.scatter(df.loc[df.peril==peril, "old"], df.loc[df.peril==peril, "new"], label=peril, alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.set_xlabel(f"Old {quantity_label}")
    ax.set_ylabel(f"New {quantity_label}")
    maximum = max([df.old.max(), df.new.max()])
    minimum = min([df.old.min(), df.new.min()])
    ax = add_ratio_lines(ax, -3, 1, 5 * maximum)
    ax.legend(prop={'size': 6})
    ax.set_ylim(0.5 * minimum, 2 * maximum)
    ax.set_xlim(ax.get_ylim())
    ax.grid(which="both", alpha=0.1)

def quantile(q: float) -> Callable:
    assert 0 < q < 1
    def func(x) -> float:
        return float(x.quantile(q))
    return func

    ]
)
bins = np.logspace(np.log10(0.1 * minimum), np.log10(10 * maximum), 25)
max_count = 1
for i, (hazard, ax) in enumerate(zip(hazards, axes)):
    for edges, label in ((old_EAD_EAEL, "Old"), (new_EAD_EAEL, "New")):
        counts, edges, patches = ax.hist(
            edges.loc[edges.hazard==hazard, "EAEL_undefended_mean"],
            bins=bins,
            label=label,
            histtype="step"
        )
        max_count = max([max_count, max(counts)])
    if i == len(hazards) - 1:
        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    if i == 0:
        ax.set_ylabel("Edge count")
    ax.set_xlabel("EAEL J$/outage day")
    ax.grid(which="both", alpha=0.2)
    ax.set_title(hazard)
    ax.set_xlim(minimum, 5 * maximum)

new_EAEL_mean_by_edge = new_EAD_EAEL_ensemble.loc[:, ["edge_id", "EAEL_undefended"]].groupby("edge_id").mean()
new_EAEL_edge_mean = new_EAD_EAEL.loc[:, ["edge_id", "EAEL_undefended_mean"]].groupby("edge_id").mean()
new_top_EAEL_edges = (100 * new_EAEL_edge_mean / new_EAEL_edge_mean.sum()) \
    .rename(columns={"EAEL_undefended_mean": "% total EAEL"}) \
    .sort_values("% total EAEL", ascending=False).iloc[:top_n]
new_top_EAEL_edges["rank"] = range(1, len(new_top_EAEL_edges) + 1)
new_edges.set_index("edge_id") \
    .loc[new_top_EAEL_edges.index, :] \
    .merge(new_top_EAEL_edges, left_index=True, right_index=True) \
    .merge(new_EAEL_mean_by_edge, left_index=True, right_index=True) \
    .to_file("new_top_EAEL.gpkg", layer="edges")
